text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (SEV2) - eu-west-2 dedicated capacity scheduler exhibiting long queueing and elevated p99 latency for reserved GPU pools. Impact: ~8% of dedicated requests see >2s tail latency, a few error spikes.

aaron (oncall): I'm taking this. seeing backlog on scheduler-worker-4; pods report request queue length growing. grabbing logs and metric snapshots.

priya (dedicated): noticed increased scheduling latency after the autoscaler debounce change last deploy (00:30 UTC). might be related. nothing obvious in allocator logs yet.

tom (infra): rolling snapshot:
```
# kubectl -n dedicated logs scheduler-worker-4 | tail -n 25
WARN 2026-06-02T00:58:12 scheduler.go:312] queue_length=1240, schedule_latency=1.8s
ERROR 2026-06-02T00:59:01 allocator.go:98] allocation failed: timeout waiting for node assignment
```

aaron (oncall): confirmed regression window ~00:30 UTC after debounce tweak. temporary mitigation: enable fast-path fallback that skips the new debounce when queue length > 200. enabling now on eu-west-2.

jen (support): heads-up: two enterprise customers reporting degraded throughput for batch inference jobs. CS notified and adding note to status page.

status-bot: Draft status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/200765 - "Investigating elevated scheduler queues in eu-west-2 impacting some Dedicated customers. Mitigation in progress."

priya (dedicated): fast-path enabled on canary scheduler-worker-1. observed immediate drop in queue: 600->60 and p99 latency 2.4s->0.6s. starting staged rollout.

tom (infra): performing staged rollout 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 2m observation windows. autoscaler will be paused on eu-west-2 during rollout to avoid churn.

aaron (oncall): monitoring queue_length, schedule_latency, and pod restart counts. if backlog doesn't shrink we will scale up reserved nodes and route traffic to reserve_zone-eu-west-2b.

jen (support): status page updated: "Mitigation underway; partial recovery observed. Eng is rolling a fix now." Contact: enterprise@redwood.ai for urgent questions.

priya (dedicated): after 2 rollout phases: overall queue down from 1.3k -> 110, p99 latency from 2.1s -> 0.7s. reserve routing not needed.

tom (infra): rolling change completed at 2026-06-02T01:08:40Z. autoscaler unpaused. no increase in pod restarts. metrics look stable.

aaron (oncall): ALERT: one customer still seeing occasional >1s tail due to a large batched job; working with CS to throttle/resubmit.

jen (support): CS update sent to affected customers; one requested incident follow-up and timeline for a permanent fix.

priya (dedicated): root cause hypothesis: debounce change introduced a path that delays allocation under sustained high enqueue rates. Action items: revert debounce semantics on scheduler, add a circuit-breaker threshold (queue len) to force fast-path, and add integration test for sustained enqueue scenarios.

sre-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/200765 - Mitigation succeeded; verification ongoing. RCA to follow.

aaron (oncall): RESOLVED: mitigations complete at 2026-06-02T01:22:00Z. marked as resolved in incident tracker. Creating follow-up RCA thread and action items in backlog. :white_check_mark:
